'''Turne''' is a mercenary captain currently under the employ of [[Perrin Aybara]].

== Appearance ==
He is lanky with curly red hair and a beard tied with leather cords.

== Activities ==
He offers to work for Perrin by being paid with food rather than money. Perrin agrees and sends him to [[Tamlin al'Thor]] for training. {{Ref/book|13|2}}

== Trivia ==
* Turne is named for Joshua Turner, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
